english translation text: LET US ALL GO TO KARBALA, OH AZADAAR’S OF IMAM

arabic text:
YA RAB HAR EK KO YE, S'ADAT NASIB HO
KARBOBALA KI SAB KO, ZIYARAT NASIB HO
CHALO KARBALA CHALE AY SHEH KE AZADAAR
YE DIL HE BEKARAAR CHALO KARBALA CHALE
english translation text:
O LORD, MAY EVERYBODY HAVE THE PRIVILEGE
TO PERFORM ZIARAT IN KARBALA
LET US ALL GO TO KARBALA, OH AZADAAR’S OF IMAM
THIS HEART IS RESTLESS – LET US ALL GO TO KARBALA

arabic text: CHALO KARBALA CHALE AY SHEH KE AZADAAR
english translation text: LET US ALL GO TO KARBALA, OH AZADAAR’S OF IMAM

arabic text: TAR APNE ASUWO SE KARENGE WO HAM ZAMIN\nKHAKAR SINAA GIRAA THA JAHA AKBARE HAZEEN\nSAB HONGE ASHKE BAR CHALO KARBALA CHALE
english translation text:
WE WILL MAKE THAT LAND WET WITH OUR TEARS
WHERE AKBAR FELL WITH A SPEAR IN HIS HEART
EVERYBODY WILL BE TEARFUL
LET US ALL GO TO KARBALA

arabic text: ABBASE NAME DAAR-E KE ROZE PE JAYENGE\nJAKAR WAHAN SAKINA KA NAWHA SUNAYENGE\nDEKHENGE WO DAYAAR CHALO KARBALA CHALE
english translation text:
WE WILL GO TO THE ROZA OF HADHRAT ABBAS
THERE WE WILL RECITE THE NAWHAS OF BIBI SAKINA
WE WILL SEE THAT PLACE
LET US ALL GO TO KARBALA

arabic text: EHLE HARAM KE KHAYME JALAYE GAYE JAHA\nMATAM KARENGE AAG KE SHOLO PE HAM WAHAA\nJAANE KARE NISAAR CHALO KARBALA CHALE
english translation text: WHERE THE TENTS OF THE HOLY FAMILY WERE BURNT\nWE WILL DO MATAM AMIDST THOSE FLAMES\nWE WILL SACRIFICE OUR LIVES - LET US GO TO KARBALA

arabic text: ASHKE GHAME HUSSAIN MILAYE FURATE ME\nNAWHO KE SAB ARIZE BAHAYE FURATE ME\nMOJO KO DE KARAAR CHALO KARBALA CHALE
english translation text: OUR TEARS FOR HUSSAIN WILL MERGE WITH THE FURAAT\nOUR ARIZA OF THESE NAWHAS WILL BE PLACED IN FURAAT\nTHE WAVES WILL BE RESTLESS - LET US ALL GO TO KARBALA

arabic text: DASHT-E BALA ME BANUE DILGIR KI FUGAA\nAB BHI SUNAYI DETI HAI ASGHAR KI HICHKIYA\nAAHO KE HAI HISAAR CHALO KARBALA CHALE
english translation text: THERE WAS A CRY OF BANO IN THE LAND OF KARBALA\nI CAN STILL HEAR ALI ASGHAR SOBBING\nTHERE IS A WAIL FROM EVERYBODY - LET US GO TO KARBALA

arabic text: PHIR BA BAREHNA JAYENGE BAZAARE SHAAM ME\nZAINAB GAYI THI JIS TARHA DARBARE AAM ME\nDIL KI HE YE PUKAR CHALO KARBALA CHALE
english translation text: THEN WE WILL GO TO SHAAM BUT WE WILL HAVE OUR HIJAB\nZAINAB WAS TAKEN THE COURT OF YAZID WITHOUT HIJAB\nOUR HEARTS CRY OUT - LET US GO TO KARBALA
